policy_contract: PLAN.md; policy C is exact cumulative squared-position error minimization at each prefix, ties by alphabet order

controls.unavailable_combo: compiler must refuse before producing a schedule
controls.one_slot_deadline: a one-slot request must emit at most one command then release
controls.omitted_release: candidate row without explicit release is an auditor error
controls.calibration_mismatch: mismatched calibrated action map must refuse; no fallback synthesis
controls.nonlinear_collision_acceleration: held-out control demonstrates prefix/final geometric objective can disagree with collision outcome; never use to tune the linear method

synthetic_effect_limit: unit commands sum as integer displacement; no claim about an actual actuator or environment
